csv_project_name: Engineering Services for Ephrata Municipal Airport Impr
csv_scope_of_work: The Grant County Port District #9 i.e., Port of Ephrata is requesting Statements of Qualifications (SOQ) from firms interested in providing consulting engineering services for the design and construction observation of improvements at the Ephrata Municipal Airport (EPH). It is anticipated that these improvements will take place over a five-year period. The improvements include, but are not limited to the following: 1. Perimeter Fencing/Security Gates for Airside Properties (2027-2029) 2. Fixed Base Operation Equipment Warehouse (2029) 3. Commercial Operation Aircraft Hangar (2030)
csv_disciplines_requested: Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Structural Engineering, Utility Engineering
